# Authoring templates

These reusable writing aids are not native GitHub issue/PR templates and do not describe implemented product functionality.

Native forms live in [ISSUE_TEMPLATE](../ISSUE_TEMPLATE/) and the [pull-request template](../PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md). Product documentation begins at [docs/README.md](../../docs/README.md).

Use the retained blog, gist, task, and workflow-document templates only when relevant. Replace illustrative fields deliberately; never add real customer data, secrets, account identifiers, or private infrastructure details. Public writing must distinguish planned behavior from verified capabilities.

Do not copy generic examples into product requirements or treat a workflow template as a working runbook. Product changes must follow [contributing guidance](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and accepted ADRs.
